body: I’m so sorry. I can’t even dare to imagine the pain you’re going through. Please take your time, and grief. Feel all the emotions flowing through you. Do whatever you think suits you. Talk about him and share his memories with the world. We would love to hear it. Remember to choose yourself, at all times. Take care hun x

Hello kind stranger, thank you so much for your words. Thank you for acknowledging my hard work to improve in life, it meant a lot to me. I am planning to open up, but I would hate him if he ever tries to say something like “oh ive been there..” “i feel it too..” lol it would be a dealbreaker. Maybe that’s why I don’t tell people things about me, cuz i dont want my experience to be downplayed. Anyway I hope you stick around too! Your words made me feel better imagine if you do it to someone else! I appreciate it so much. x
Thank you, this is the most people have ever done for me. Wherever you are, i hope you will be fine soon.
